sources.text: Incident ticket OPS-882: on 2026-10-18, the order service returned duplicate confirmations for a subset of requests after a retry configuration change.
Service log: retry policy r17 deployed at 09:42 UTC; request IDs and duplicate count are available, but the supplied extract does not show downstream order reconciliation.
Response record: retry policy reverted at 10:15 UTC; customer impact assessment, reconciliation completion, and approved root-cause review are not attached.
